intuition.title: Study context: Pore loading
intuition.text: The authors propose that capillary filling introduces AgNO3/ethanol into silica mesochannels; evaporation leaves adsorbed silver and nitrate species. The AS complex remains tentative.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 2, Impregnation and adsorption discussion

intuition.title: Study context: Thermal assembly
intuition.text: The source interprets 300 °C treatment as nitrate decomposition and formation/redistribution of Ag clusters. A periodic surface stress field is proposed to influence array organization; the intrinsic driving force remains unresolved.

intuition.title: Study context: Scale and stability
intuition.text: Ag line width/gaps/periodicity and silica mesoporosity are distinct length scales. Larger particles after 500 °C and beam-stable square arrays are source observations, not a continuous predictive growth model.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 2–3, Figures 3–4 and 500 °C follow-up

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
